difficulty_reason: Smooth = lfp + formally smooth for algebraic stacks: (1) implies (2) by lfp permanence and the fibre-product square reduction to the lift-to-smooth lemma; (2) implies (1) by choosing a smooth presentation and running the representable-transformations principle twice (a formally smooth from the spaces equivalence, composition with formally smooth f gives b formally smooth, principle again gives b smooth), concluding f smooth by definition.
